name: AMC Liquid Tabs
description: Tab navigation whose indicator behaves like a drop of liquid: it stretches toward the hovered or focused tab through an SVG goo filter and snaps back to the current page, instead of the flat underline of classic tabs.
useFor: Page-level or section tabs on a List region: switching between sibling pages such as Dashboard, Orders, Invoices and Reports, or the tabs of a record page. One level; sub entries are ignored.
helpText: List template for tab navigation. Each entry is a real link; the current entry gets aria-current=page. Attribute 1 is a count badge that is hidden when empty. With JavaScript the indicator is a liquid pill that stretches toward the hovered or keyboard-focused tab and returns to the current tab; without JavaScript, and under prefers-reduced-motion, the current tab shows a static pill and nothing moves. The strip scrolls horizontally in narrow containers, fades its edges while scrolling and scrolls the current tab into view. Template options: Solid pill fills the indicator with the primary color; Liquid underline turns it into a stretching drop under the label; Fill width spreads the tabs across the region; Large raises the tab height; No track removes the tray behind the tabs. Forced-colors mode shows the current tab with a system outline.

templateOptions.name: Solid pill
templateOptions.help: The liquid pill uses the primary color and the tab on it switches to the primary contrast color.

templateOptions.name: Liquid underline
templateOptions.help: Replaces the pill with a primary drop under the label that stretches between tabs; the tray becomes a hairline.

templateOptions.name: Fill width
templateOptions.help: Tabs share the full width of the region, for two to five tabs.

templateOptions.name: Large
templateOptions.help: Taller tabs with larger text, for page headers and touch screens.

templateOptions.name: No track
templateOptions.help: Removes the tray behind the tabs so only the liquid pill remains, for colored hero regions.
